prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Atlanta to replace my air conditioner?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” HVAC company for everybody — the right contractor depends on your location in Atlanta, the size/age of your home, what brand or efficiency level you want, your budget, and timing. That said, here’s a practical way to find the best company for your AC replacement plus a few reputable names you can start with.

Quick starter list (well-known, generally well-reviewed in the Atlanta area)
- Coolray (Coolray & Mr. Plumber) — large regional company, lots of service availability
- Moncrief Heating & Air — established Atlanta-area HVAC contractor
- Service Experts Heating & Air Conditioning — national brand with local Atlanta offices
- Aire Serv (local franchise operators) — franchised coverage with local techs

How to choose the best contractor for your situation
1. Get 3 written estimates. Compare total installed price, equipment model (SEER rating), labor warranty, and permit handling.  
2. Require a Manual J load calculation. Don’t accept right-size guesses — proper sizing prevents comfort and efficiency problems.  
3. Check credentials: NATE-certified technicians, manufacturer dealer certifications (Trane, Carrier, Lennox, etc.), proof of insurance, and local business license.  
4. Read recent reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB) and ask for recent local references.  
5. Ask about warranties: equipment warranty + labor/installation warranty and what voids the warranty (e.g., improper installation).  
6. Confirm permits and code compliance: reputable contractors handle permits and inspections.  
7. Ask about rebates/financing and about removal/disposal of the old unit.  
8. Verify seasonality and timing: summer can be busy — schedule ahead for best pricing/availability.

Good questions to ask when getting a quote
- Will you perform a Manual J and provide the calculation?  
- Which brand and model are you recommending and why? What SEER?  
- What is included in the installation (new thermostat, line sets, pads, electrical, refrigerant charge, duct modifications)?  
- What are the warranties (equipment and labor)? Are there any exclusions?  
- Can you provide references from recent local installations?

If you want, I can:
- Look up the top-rated HVAC contractors for your specific Atlanta neighborhood (I’ll need your zip code), or  
- Help you prepare an email/script to request quotes from contractors, or  
- Explain how to evaluate the equipment models you're being offered.

Which would you prefer?
